metadata.description: Marketplace for the kanban plugin - Markdown kanban boards for Claude Code.

plugins.name: kanban
plugins.description: Markdown-based kanban boards - three surfaces over one board of *.card.md files: kanban (AI card management), web (human live editor, a local server), artifact (the web built with the board inside, as a hosted Board artifact or a single file, for phone/tablet/Cowork)
